Without settings.json CS2 is found through Steam and addon is mcp_lab. addon: the only CS2 addon this tool writes to. compile_threads 0 = all cores. blender: path to blender.exe ("" = search tools/, Steam libraries, Program Files). limits: disk caps applied hourly at server start; files named in README/docs/reports are never removed.
